subject: Post-demo: FinBank KMS/Encryption follow-up
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@finbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:15:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: FinBank KMS/Encryption follow-up

Hi Alice - thanks again for the demo call this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side: \n\- High-level asks we captured: SOC 2 evidence, GDPR/HIPAA posture, vendor security questionnaire completion, and detailed KMS/BYOK options for encryption at-rest and in-transit.\n\- Encryption summary (high level):\n  - In-transit: TLS 1.2+ by default for all API and internal service traffic.\n  - At-rest: AES-256 envelope encryption for customer data.\n  - KMS options: Redwood-managed keys (default) or customer-managed keys (BYOK) via AWS KMS for Hosted/Dedicated. For Private/on-prem we support HSM-backed keys and customer HSM integrations.\n\nAttachments: I’ve attached a one-pager (redwood-kms-options.pdf) that outlines customer-managed key support and typical deployment patterns, plus an editable vendor questionnaire (vendor-security-questionnaire-FinBank.xlsx) we can start filling out.\n\nProposed next steps:\n- We’ll start populating the questionnaire and mark which items need evidence (SOC report, pen test, architecture diagrams).\n- Can we schedule a 30-min follow-up with your security team and our security engineer to walk through the KMS options? I proposed Wed, Nov 24, 10am PT - does that work for you?\n\nThanks - I’ll also cc our security lead for technical Qs.\n\nBest,\nCamila Reyes\nEnterprise Sales | Redwood Inference\ncamila.reyes@redwood.ai\n(415) 555-0123\n\--\nAttachment stubs:\n- redwood-kms-options.pdf (application/pdf, 1 page)\n- vendor-security-questionnaire-FinBank.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, editable)

From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@finbank.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: FinBank Security Team <security@finbank.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T11:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: FinBank KMS/Encryption follow-up

Camila - thanks for the recap and for the docs. A few quick clarifying Qs before we set the deeper call: \n\1) SOC 2: do you have a current SOC 2 Type II report we can review (or an expected recertification date)? If there’s an NDA process to retrieve the report please send the link or steps.\n2) BYOK specifics: can Redwood support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS (CMKs) for the hosted offering, and do you support hardware-backed keys (HSM) for Private deployments? We need to understand key lifecycle, rotation, and whether Redwood retains any access to unwrapped keys.\n3) Data residency: we operate in US-only regions for a subset of data - can you confirm regions and whether CMK + regional restrictions are supported?\n\nWe’re happy for you to start putting answers into the questionnaire; security@finbank.com will be managing the formal submission. Also please include any quick attestation matrix (yes/no) next to each row so our GRC team can triage.\n\Thanks - I’m copying our security inbox so they see the attachments. Nov 24 10am PT should work; will confirm by EOD.\n\-Alice Monroe\nDirector, InfoSec\nFinBank

From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@finbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T13:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: FinBank KMS/Encryption follow-up

Hi Alice - great questions, answered inline below for quick triage. I’ll have our security engineer provide the deeper technical artifacts on the follow-up call and we’ll populate the questionnaire with evidence links.\n\1) SOC 2: Redwood maintains a SOC 2 Type II report. We share the report under NDA; our standard process is a one-way NDA and then we provide a downloadable report via a secure link. I will loop in our legal/security team to initiate that if you’d like.\n\2) BYOK specifics: short answers here: \n   - Hosted (Redwood API): supports customer-managed keys via AWS KMS (CMK) for encryption-at-rest using envelope encryption. Redwood does not retain unencrypted key material; we use KMS to perform encryption/decryption operations per request and only store key identifiers.\n   - Dedicated (reserved capacity): supports CMK in the same manner; keys can be regional and attached to the dedicated VPC.\n   - Private/on-prem: we support HSM-backed keys and can integrate with customer HSMs or KMS-HSM configurations; this is the recommended path when you require FIPS 140-2 Level 3 hardware guarantees.\n   - Key rotation & access: Typical rotation is driven by the customer via CMK policies; Redwood supports rotation schedules and exposes key identifiers in logs for audit. We do not retain access to unwrapped customer keys; operational support requiring access to encrypted data would run through a documented emergency access process with approvals.\n\3) Data residency: Yes - Hosted & Dedicated deployments can be pinned to a region (US: us-west-2, us-east-1). CMKs can be region-specific; for strict residency we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments so keys and encrypted data remain in your VPC/region.\n\Next steps (proposed):\n- I’ll begin populating the questionnaire with the high-level answers above and flag items requiring your evidence (SOC report, architecture diagram, key rotation policy).\n- Marissa (cc’d) will introduce Rishi from our security engineering team for the technical walkthrough; Rishi can also provide sample key-policy snippets and rotation controls.\n- We’ll start the NDA flow to share the SOC report - confirm where to send the NDA (security@finbank.com OK?).\n\Confirming the proposed call: Nov 24, 10am PT - will send calendar invite once Alice confirms.\n\Thanks,\nCamila Reyes\nEnterprise Sales | Redwood Inference\ncamila.reyes@redwood.ai\n\--\nPopulated attachments: vendor-security-questionnaire-FinBank.xlsx (we added preliminary answers and a notes column)
